data.completion_memo: Implemented explicit non-authoritative rebind plans that require a new child branch and fresh authority, plus guarded reachable-object retention planning.
data.description: Implement the non-authoritative local capability rebind planner and the branch/object integrity and retention engine. Explicit continuation must produce a new child Chat/branch with fresh bindings, snapshot, authority, and approvals. Integrity work may propose exact non-destructive repairs and collect only provably unreachable objects after grace; it must never rewrite published history or choose a tip by time.
data.title: M06.7 — Implement portable rebinding, integrity, repair, and retention decisions
